A cold changed declaration builds more than once, the build-count instrument sees no known cold build, or both declarations done fails to produce independently derived closable readiness; both implicit and explicit checkout paths are exercised.

The initial whole-plan dependency is not blocked or completing upstream declarations leaves target stale/blocked, including a subsequent target write; bypassing key matching provably fails 186 through 127.
An unchanged warm snapshot changes its answer or does any roadmap build; comparing first and second observed answers is not comparing an output to a value supplied as input.
Appending a promoted unlanded store row fails to trigger a fresh build or the independent roadmap misses the run-not-landed finding; removing store_stamp from the key leaves builds empty at 250.
The profiler fails to observe the landing audit or measured wall time less its observed cumulative audit time exceeds five seconds; the equality helper additionally checks the timed edit response.
No assertions were added here; moving failure injection to _plan_readiness_report retains the existing persistence-after-read-failure checks.
